
### sockaddr_in  {.smaller}


<pre><code>/* from 'man 7 ip' */
struct sockaddr_in {
   <span data-fragment-index="3" class="fragment custom myem-only">sa_family_t    sin_family</span>; /* address family: always AF_INET */
   <span data-fragment-index="2" class="fragment custom myem-only">in_port_t      sin_port</span>;   /* port in network byte order */
   <span data-fragment-index="2" class="fragment custom myem-only">struct in_addr sin_addr</span>;   /* internet address */
};

/* Internet address. */
struct in_addr {
   <span data-fragment-index="2" class="fragment custom myem-only">uint32_t       s_addr</span>;     /* address in network byte order */
};
</code></pre>

### sockaddr_in6  {.smaller}


<pre><code>/* from 'man 7 ipv6' */
struct sockaddr_in6 {
   sa_family_t     sin6_family;   /* always AF_INET6 */
   <span data-fragment-index="2" class="fragment custom myem-only">in_port_t       sin6_port</span>;     /* port number */
   uint32_t        sin6_flowinfo; /* IPv6 flow information */
   <span data-fragment-index="2" class="fragment custom myem-only">struct in6_addr sin6_addr</span>;     /* IPv6 address */
   uint32_t        sin6_scope_id; /* Scope ID (new in 2.4) */
};

struct in6_addr {
   <span data-fragment-index="2" class="fragment custom myem-only">unsigned char   s6_addr[16]</span>;   /* IPv6 address */
};
</code></pre>
